C-3.action: Schema manifest rewritten. Actual names: growth_logs, activity_logs, immunisations (British), enrollments. progress_notes removed entirely (not present). newborn_enrollments removed (not present). Added: nutrition_logs, wellbeing_logs, notification_preferences, notification_queue, phone_otps, push_subscriptions, lesson_progress. All field names verified against migration source files.

C-4.finding: children.parent used throughout R18. Actual relation field is children.user.
C-4.action: All test bodies, CRUD functions, legacy fixtures, and schema references updated to use 'user' not 'parent'.

C-5.finding: articles.type with values antenatal/postnatal/general was assumed. Actual field is articles.category with values growth/nutrition/activity/wellbeing/immunisation/pregnancy/general. articles.is_pregnancy bool is the actual antenatal gate.
C-5.action: Schema manifest corrected. Test manifest updated. T-ART-ANON-DENIED removed as a scored test (articles are currently publicly readable — policy decision required). T-ART-ANON-POLICY added (policy decision required). T-ART-CATEGORY-FILTER added.

C-6.action: HOOK_SRC_PATHS updated: removed onboarding, removed alias_intercept. Added: emergency_hardening (emergency_users_hardening.pb.js), auth_whatsapp_otp (auth_whatsapp_otp.pb.js). Keys now: emergency_hardening, auth_whatsapp_otp, push_broadcast, whatsapp.

C-7.finding: T-ANON-INJECT treated as a single test; classified as a prediction (not a verified finding); no persisted-record verification.
C-7.action: Replaced by five separate EMERGENCY BLOCKING tests: T-INJECT-CREATE-ANON-ADMIN, T-INJECT-CREATE-ANON-SADMIN, T-INJECT-CREATE-VERIFIED, T-INJECT-CREATE-EMAIL-VIS, T-INJECT-CREATE-UNEXPECTED. Each verifies the persisted record via native superuser read, not just the HTTP response code.

C-8.finding: T-ART-ANON-DENIED classified as a predicted FAIL. Was not separated from verified static findings.
C-8.action: Reclassified as T-ART-ANON-POLICY — a policy decision required item, not a scored pass/fail. The static finding (articles.listRule is public) is documented separately from whether this is the intended policy.

C-9.finding: OTP concurrency section still referenced Mailhog in certain code paths despite R18 redesign.
C-9.action: All Mailhog references removed. HOOK_OTP_PHONE_ROUTE resolved to /api/auth/request-whatsapp-otp. Local OTP test adapter designed (/api/test/otp-control).
